## The general term {#ss5-general-term .gp-lesson .gp-formula-sheet}

Reaching term $n$ from term $1$ takes **$n-1$ multiplications** by $r$.

::: {.split .gp-formula-layout}
::: {.column-block}
::: {.takeaway .fragment data-fragment-index="0"}

$$a_n=\textcolor{#3b66a8}{a}\,\textcolor{#b55224}{r^{n-1}}\qquad(n\ge1)$$

:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}

$$n=1:\quad a_1=ar^0=a$$

$$n=4:\quad a_4=ar^3$$

The index $n$ is a positive integer.

:::
:::
